Kit summary

Jolly Easter EggBasic
Deals 280% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 35% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Dedicated SpiritActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
An ally is possessed by Esther and gains [Inspiration]. Grants the ally with [Inspiration] a Shield by 80% of Esther's Max HP. Frees the ally from Esther's possession and removes [Inspiration] when the [Shield] of the ally with [Inspiration] is destroyed or at the wave transition. Esther possesses the ally with the highest ATK when self is targeted. When Esther is the only one survived among the allies, all allies revive with 30% of Max HP. Afterward, Esther dies and cannot revive. Every 1% of Esther's initial Healing Effect increases the Direct DMG dealt by the ally with [Inspiration] by 0.5%, up to 50%.
Fun Easter Egg Lv.2Restores all allies' HP by 12% of Esther's Max HP when an ally is possessed by Esther. Besides, increases the Direct DMG percentage improvement of the ally with [Inspiration] to 0.8% and improvement cap to 80%.
Fun Easter Egg Lv.3Esther acts for 1 turn immediately after casting Dedicated Spirit. Increases the owner's Turn Meter by 25% when switching the type of [Inspiration] each time. The initial type of [Inspiration] will remain for 3 turns.
Cunning BunnyPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
There is a 25% chance to gain immunity to the DMG each time the DMG is dealt to her when Esther is under control status. Besides, Esther will leave an [Egg of Life] to fight in her place after possessing an ally. When the ally is free from her possession, Esther replaces [Egg of life] and refreshes all her skill CD. [Egg of Life] is immune to control effects and reduces DMG taken by 40%. Meanwhile, there is a 25% chance to gain immunity to the DMG each time the DMG is dealt to it. Frees the ally from the possession when [Egg of Life] is killed.
Fun Easter Egg Lv.1Increases self Turn Meter by 30% at the beginning of each wave. Besides, [Easter Egg · Colorful] is stackable up to 3 layers. Consumes only 1 layer when triggered each time. Refreshes the duration of all [Easter Egg · Colorful] when inflicted each time.
Fun Easter Egg Lv.2Restores all allies' HP by 12% of Esther's Max HP when an ally is possessed by Esther. Besides, increases the Direct DMG percentage improvement of the ally with [Inspiration] to 0.8% and improvement cap to 80%.

Grants 1 layer of [Easter Egg · Colorful] to all allies for 3 turns, up to 1 layer. Cannot have other [Easter Egg] effects when the [Easter Egg · Colorful] is owned. Removes [Easter Egg · Colorful] when any of the following effects is triggered: [Easter Egg · Red]: Triggered when an ally with [Easter Egg · Colorful] kills an enemy. Acts for an extra turn. [Easter Egg · Yellow]: Triggered when an ally with [Easter Egg · Colorful] dies. Revives with 30% of Max HP and this effect cannot be triggered by the ally again for the next 3 turns. [Easter Egg · Blue]: Triggered when the buffs owned by an ally with [Easter Egg · Colorful] are removed. Reduces all enemies' Turn Meter by 8%.
